patthana16.80:1.1: dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassana appaṭigho na dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā cha.
patthana16.80:2.1: anidassana appaṭighaṃ na dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na sanidassana sappaṭigho na na dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi. anidassana appaṭighaṃ
